name: Jordan
source:
Two years ago, they stopped speaking to each other. Now, Jordan and her past high school friends are deciding to hang out again—at the abandoned mansion.

Play as Jordan in this visual novel and puzzle horror game as she uncovers what really split the group apart and makes choices to save her friends. Who will you be able to save?

[From [url=https://theaman.itch.io/jordan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两年前，他们与彼此断了联系。如今，乔丹和高中时代的朋友们决定再次相聚，地点是一座废弃宅邸。

在这款结合视觉小说与解谜玩法的恐怖游戏中，你将扮演乔丹，查明当初让这群朋友分道扬镳的真相，并作出选择，设法救下他们。你究竟能救谁？

[摘自[url=https://theaman.itch.io/jordan]Itch.io[/url]]
